Reports=3. Flood polygons stored=3. list features=3 kept for Thailand=3. GDACS data are published as free to use by the European Commission JRC. Terms: https://www.gdacs.org/Documents/2025/GDACS_API_quickstart_v2.pdf and https://www.gdacs.org/gdacsapi/swagger/index.html. The client read robots.txt as text, enforced Request-rate 1/60 and Visit-time 0400-0645 UTC, and would have refused the call if that file could not be read. The list body came from the local cache of a visit-window fetch.

Level 5 in this feed's own scale is น้ำล้นตลิ่ง (over bank); level 1 is น้ำน้อยวิกฤติ (critically low), not a flood class.
